title: Writing / Brand Narrative / The Duolingo difference
slide_intent: Give a broad promise distinct supporting reasons so prospective learners can understand what makes the offer relevant.
strategic_value: The combination of access, motivating lessons, inclusion, support and continued development can make Duolingo’s positioning easier to explain.
demonstration: Six paragraphs on the right emphasize differentiating claims in bold, beside a short explanation of why learners choose Duolingo.
practical_value: Choose which supporting reason fits a communication without treating the historical claims as current measurements.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Difference title and learner-choice caption at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Set six paragraphs in one pale panel at right; bold the phrases naming popularity, availability, motivation, inclusion, encouragement and ongoing development.

reference_purposes.Intent: The left caption frames the list as reasons learners choose Duolingo.
reference_purposes.Expression: Bold phrases embedded in conversational paragraphs demonstrate the historical positioning voice.
